test_i3d_model_shapes_with_squeeze: test the I3D model with spatial squeeze enabled and verify output shapes match expected dimensions
test_i3d_model_shapes_without_squeeze: test the I3D model with spatial squeeze disabled and verify output shapes include spatial dimensions
test_i3d_init_errors: test the I3D model initialization errors for invalid endpoint, invalid dropout, and invalid input dimensions
test_i3d_model_training_modes: test the I3D model in training and inference modes with different dropout keep probabilities
test_i3d_predictions_and_logits: test the I3D model predictions and logits output shapes for batched video input tensors
